summaries.docs-writer: Writes and edits the markdown documents of `docs/` in place, checks what they say against the thing itself, backs one up before a rewrite
summaries.docs-workflow: How work is done in `docs/`: what a document is, find, back up, check, edit in place; the two commands, the settings keys
summaries.docs-write: `/docs-write <name> [what it should say]`: finds or starts the document, checks before writing, edits the file in place and says what changed
summaries.docs-write-a-document: A new session that writes a reference document, checked against what it describes
